title: [Bug] Connection tabs do not size depending on the connection name length
author: sassy-lily
body_snippet: Connection tabs are always of the same fixed size, making it impossible to distinguish connections with names longer than five characters: Tabs should resize according to the length of the connection name, so the name is fully shown. A maximum size may be defined to prevent rogue names from wrecking the tabs bar, but five characters is way too short (currently tab...
